title: Fix Spatial Play Render Loop
description: Fix React infinite loop in SpatialPlayModelSpaceProvider from uncached AppPointerFocusStore getSnapshot; remove ineffective frame-ancestors CSP meta from cad play index.html.
summary: Fixed CadPlayModelSpaceProvider React infinite loop: AppPointerFocusStore now caches getSnapshot and only notifies when selection/hover/source actually change. Removed redundant publish on unchanged setHoverFromSource. Added stable-snapshot unit test. @semio-tech/framework-core (17) and @semio-tech/cad-js-renderer (50) tests pass.
